title: ON HATE SCALING LAWS FOR DATA-SWAMPS
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct its own benchmark measurement for religion. It cites prior work that measured anti-Muslim bias in GPT-3's generated text by analyzing the violence in completions for prompts including the word 'Muslim'.
models_tested: OpenCLIP (ViT-L-14 architecture trained on OpenAI-WIT, LAION-400M, and LAION-2B-en datasets)
findings: The paper's own experiments did not produce findings on religion. It cites prior research which found that including the word 'Muslim' in prompts to GPT-3 resulted in violent text completions in 66 out of 100 cases, a rate higher than for other religions.
